faqs.question: What is PRO400PC used for?
faqs.answer: PRO400PC is a programmable benchtop homogenizer used for repetitive homogenizing in laboratory or industrial settings, supporting stored multi-step speed and time protocols.

faqs.question: How many cycles can one program hold?
faqs.answer: Each program can hold up to 23 unique cycles, with each cycle independently defining speed, run time, and pause before the next.

faqs.question: How many programs can be stored?
faqs.answer: An infinite number of programs can be created and stored on the unit.

faqs.question: How is PRO400PC programmed?
faqs.answer: Programming happens either from the unit's own keypad or from a laptop or desktop computer via RS232 serial communication, using the included PROgrammable software.

faqs.question: Can I switch to manual control during a program?
faqs.answer: Yes, the PC-Series homogenizer can be overridden and manual control resumed at any point.

faqs.question: Does PRO400PC support documented process verification?
faqs.answer: Yes, it meets industry requirements for verification of processing and documentation maintenance, with data logged as set vs. actual speed and time.

faqs.question: Can homogenization data be exported or printed?
faqs.answer: Yes, both programs and collected data can be stored and recalled for screen display or printout.

faqs.question: What processing volume can PRO400PC handle?
faqs.answer: It processes samples from 0.05 mL to 30 L, with higher volumes dependent on viscosity.

faqs.question: Does PRO400PC come with a generator probe?
faqs.answer: No, a generator probe or chamber assembly is required to operate the unit and is sold separately.

faqs.question: Is there an Extra Length version of PRO400PC?
faqs.answer: Yes, PRO400PCEL offers an Extra Length stand for taller containers, while PRO400PC includes the standard 14.5-inch PRO TRAC stand.

faqs.question: What is the price of PRO400PC in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the probe, chamber assembly, and software configuration selected. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of PRO400PC in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the ProScientific PRO400PC in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroLead: Repetitive homogenizing eats into lab time when every run needs manual oversight. PRO400PC is built to run that repetition on its own, exactly the same way, every time. A 1305 watt motor powers processing from 0.05 mL to 30 L, with programs stored either from the unit's own keypad or from a laptop or desktop over RS232 serial communication using the included PROgrammable software. Each program holds up to 23 unique cycles, defining speed, run time, and pause between cycles, and an infinite number of programs can be created and stored. body.text: Repetitive homogenizing runs with minimum operator attention once a program is built, whether in a laboratory or industrial setting.
Programming happens either from the unit's own keypad or from a laptop or desktop computer via RS232 serial communication, using the included PROgrammable software.
An infinite number of programs can be created and stored, each holding up to 23 unique cycles that individually define speed, run time, and the pause between cycles.
Manual control can override an active program at any point, without needing to abandon the automated setup entirely.
Data can be graphed directly on the computer screen as homogenization proceeds, tracking both set values and actual performance.
Both programs and collected data, set time and set speed versus actual time and actual speed, can be stored and recalled for screen display or printout.
This traceability meets industry requirements for verification of processing and documentation maintenance.
Processing volume spans microliters to multi-liters, designed to homogenize, emulsify, blend, and mix organic and inorganic materials.
The included PRO TRAC motorized stand provides 14.5 inches of length for a standard container, with effortless, accurate, and smooth motor positioning.
A generator probe or chamber assembly is required to operate the unit and is sold separately.

paragraphs: Many homogenizing protocols aren't a single speed held for a single duration, they're a sequence: ramp up, hold, pause, adjust, repeat. PRO400PC is built to hold that entire sequence as one program rather than requiring manual re-entry at every step.

Each program stores up to 23 unique cycles, and each cycle independently defines its own speed, run time, and the pause before the next cycle begins. Programs build either directly from the unit's keypad for standalone use, or from a laptop or desktop computer over RS232 serial communication using the included PROgrammable software, useful when a protocol is complex enough to benefit from a full computer interface. Because an infinite number of programs can be created and stored, every distinct protocol a lab runs gets its own saved sequence rather than being reconstructed from notes each time.

sections.title: Documentation and Process Verification
sections.tabSummary: Meeting industry requirements for traceable data
body: How PRO400PC's data logging supports industry-standard process verification.
Knowing a homogenization run happened isn't the same as being able to prove it ran exactly as specified, and that gap is exactly what PRO400PC's data logging is built to close.

As a run proceeds, data graphs directly on the computer screen in real time, showing the process as it happens rather than only after the fact. Both the program itself and the data collected, set time and set speed measured against actual time and actual speed, can be stored and recalled later, whether for screen display or as a printed record. That level of traceable documentation is what lets PRO PC homogenizer units meet industry requirements for verification of processing and ongoing documentation maintenance.
